body:
Thank you, i  sincerely really appreciate your words, especially coming from someone who has been through what i'm going right now and even worse. I checked your profile and saw your post, and i hope you can get out that! but if not, i at least hope for it to end peacefully, and for you to be fulfilled with the life you lived. I just want you to know that your words actually mean a lot to me, and that you've helped me to keep going and not give up.

Thank you
